# Austin Park Dental

> > A comprehensive family and cosmetic dental practice in Barberton, OH serving Summit County and surrounding areas with preventive care, restorative procedures, and advanced imaging technology.

Austin Park Dental is a full-service dental practice led by Dr. Lynn Herpy and Dr. Bruce Herpy, both graduates of Ohio State University. The practice offers general dentistry, cosmetic procedures, emergency care, and utilizes advanced diagnostic imaging including 3D cone beam technology and CEREC same-day crowns.

## Key Topics

- Family Dentistry
- Cosmetic Dentistry
- Preventive Care
- Dental Implants
- Emergency Dentistry
- CEREC Same-Day Crowns
- 3D Imaging (i-CAT)
- Oral Cancer Screening
- Teeth Whitening
- Dental Exams & Cleanings
- Digital X-Rays
- Dr. Lynn Herpy
- Dr. Bruce Herpy
- Barberton, OH
- Summit County

## Preventive & General Care

- [Cleanings & Prevention](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention): Preventive dental care including cleanings, exams, and fluoride treatments.
- [Dental Exams & Cleanings](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/dental-exams-cleanings): Professional dental exams and cleanings with oral cancer screening.
- [Oral Cancer Exam](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/oral-cancer-exam): Oral cancer screening and early detection examination procedure.
- [Fluoride Treatment](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/fluoride-treatment): Professional fluoride treatment for tooth decay prevention and oral health.
- [Simple Tooth Extractions](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/simple-tooth-extractions): Simple tooth extraction procedure for periodontal disease and tooth removal.
- [Home Care Guide](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/home-care): Home oral hygiene care guide with ADA-recommended tools and techniques.
- [How to Properly Brush & Floss](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/how-to-properly-brush-floss): ADA-approved brushing and flossing techniques for preventive dental health.
- [Oral Hygiene Aids](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/oral-hygiene-aids): FDA-approved oral hygiene tools including Waterpiks and interdental cleaners.

## Cosmetic Dentistry

- [Cosmetic Dentistry Services](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry): Cosmetic dentistry services including whitening, veneers, and bonding.
- [CEREC Same-Day Crowns](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry/cerec): CEREC same-day ceramic crown technology using CAD-CAM restoration.
- [Composite Bonding](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cosmetic-dentistry/bonding): Composite resin bonding for chipped teeth and smile gap closure.

## Advanced Dental Imaging

- [Digital X-Rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/digital-x-rays): Digital radiography X-ray technology for safe diagnostic dental imaging.
- [Dental X-Rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/dental-x-rays): Dental X-ray diagnostic imaging for preventive care and patient education.
- [Panoramic X-rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/panoramic-x-rays): Panoramic X-ray imaging for wisdom teeth and dental implant assessment.
- [Cephalometric X-rays](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/cephalometric-x-rays): Cephalometric X-ray imaging for orthodontic planning and dental implants.
- [i-CAT 3D Imaging](https://www.austinparkdental.com/procedures/cleanings-prevention/i-cat-3d-imaging): 3D cone beam imaging technology for dental implants and oral surgery planning.
